steps.command: python3 -c "import json,os,re,sys,unicodedata as u;P=sys.argv[1];loc=re.search(r'[(](en|el|ru)[)]',P).group(1);T=re.search(r'Text: .(.*). Question:',P,re.S).group(1);c={k:sum(1 for ch in T if ch.isalpha() and u.name(ch,'').startswith(k)) for k in ('GREEK','LATIN','CYRILLIC')};want={'en':'LATIN','el':'GREEK','ru':'CYRILLIC'}[loc];share=c[want]/(sum(c.values()) or 1);put=lambda o:json.dump(o,open(os.path.join(os.environ['FLEET_OUTPUT_DIR'],'output.json'),'w'));dec=lambda:json.load(open(os.path.join(os.environ['FLEET_INPUT_DIR'],'decide','output.json')));put({'answer':c,'p':1 if share>=0.5 else 0,'answered_by':'script','tokens':None})" ${example.prompt}
